name: Discord Notifications
description: Sends notifications to a Discord channel via webhook for Drupal content, user, system, and security events.
project_description: The Discord Notifications module posts messages to a Discord channel through an incoming webhook whenever selected Drupal events occur. It wires core entity and user hooks (node insert/update/delete, user login/insert/update, cron, failed login, password reset) to a single notification service that builds a color-coded Discord embed and POSTs it to the configured webhook URL using Drupal's HTTP client. An administrator configures a webhook URL and ticks which of four event groups (content, user, system, security) should fire, plus optional @here or @everyone mentions. The module has no entities, plugins, permissions of its own, or Drush commands; its entire surface is one settings form, one config object, and one service.
